description: This file defines the interface `JsonFieldSelector` in the package `org.eclipse.ditto.json`. It specifies the contract for objects that represent a selection of JSON fields, capable of handling multiple JSON pointers, and includes static factory methods for instantiation. The interface emphasizes immutability and provides methods for retrieving pointers, size, emptiness, and string representation.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new `JsonFieldSelector` based on provided JSON pointer strings via the `JsonFactory`.

methods.name: getPointers
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable set of `JsonPointer` instances that this selector is based on.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of JSON pointers contained in this field selector.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the field selector contains any JSON pointers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the field selector, either the original selector string or a default representation.
